Cytochrome b sequences from four leporid species

Source: R/data.R
lepus_cytb.Rd

Real mitochondrial cytochrome b (cytb) records downloaded from NCBI nuccore for three hare species (Lepus granatensis, L. timidus, L. europaeus) — all flagged as population-genetic candidates in the EcoSeek genominer database (https://genominer.ecoseek.org) — plus the European rabbit (Oryctolagus cuniculus) as an outgroup.

Usage

lepus_cytb

Format

A data.frame with 37 rows and 4 columns:

accession

NCBI nuccore accession (character).

species

Species epithet: granatensis, timidus, europaeus or cuniculus (character).

title

Full NCBI FASTA header (character).

sequence

Nucleotide sequence as downloaded, untrimmed (character, 400–1200 bp; MN098958.1 contains one IUPAC ambiguity code, W).

Source

NCBI nuccore, downloaded 2026-09-24; see data-raw/lepus_cytb.R in the source repository for the exact eutils queries and snapshot FASTAs.

Details

Sequences are shipped exactly as retrieved: mixed lengths, untrimmed, and including two mislabelled records (XM_017337704.3 and XM_051846530.2, predicted nuclear mRNAs that a "cytochrome b" title search returns but that are not the mitochondrial gene). The lepus-cytb vignette uses them to show that a near-zero local alignment score flags a mislabelled record.

Examples

data(lepus_cytb)
table(lepus_cytb$species)
#> 
#>   cuniculus   europaeus granatensis     timidus 
#>           8           8          13           8 
align(lepus_cytb$sequence[1:3], lepus_cytb$sequence[2], smax = 200)
#>   score resolved
#> 1    89     TRUE
#> 2     0     TRUE
#> 3    NA    FALSE
#>                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  cigar
